newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Asia Pulp to issue $120 mln FRNs in Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pulp to issue $120 mln FRNs in Taiwan.

text.p: Singapore's Asia Pulp & Paper will issue US$120 million in floating rate notes (FRNs) on September 10 in Taiwan to raise funds for its paper plant venture in Malaysia, the Commercial Times newspaper reported on Saturday.
The FRN will have a five-year term, the local newspaper said.
Union Bank of Switzerland and four local banks will be lead underwriters for the FRN issue, the paper said.
The four local banks include First Commercial Bank and state-run Chiao Tung Bank, it said.
The banks could not be reached for comment.
Asia Pulp is a Singapore firm listed in the United States, the paper said.
